description:
FILED s533b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-03) from the requalifier port's neighbour probes (scratch/s533b/pr/N5.pl, r8.pl in the s533b worktree); not present in the four populations (D0 found no site), FIXED BY THE PORT (s533b): two homes the legacy scope walk gave wrong and the binder gives right.

(1) A name perl forces into main:: (gv.c S_gv_is_in_main: ENV INC ARGV ARGVOUT SIG STDIN STDOUT STDERR _) in a sigil the requalifier's immune list does not carry:

    sub run { package U; $main::STDOUT = "ms"; @main::ENV = ("ok"); print "so=$STDOUT env=$ENV[0]\n" } run();

perl: so=ms env=ok          base 4fb60297: so= env=   (requalified to $U::STDOUT / @U::ENV)
The binder's kind `special` homes it to main (the immune list still keeps $_ @_ %ENV ... unrewritten, as before).

(2) A `package NAME { }` BLOCK inside a `package X;` switched region: its globals were requalified to X.

    sub run { package U; package U2 { $y = "u2y" } print "U2::y=", $U2::y // 'u', " U::y=", $U::y // 'u', "\n" } run();

perl: U2::y=u2y U::y=u       base: U2::y=u U::y=u2y
The binder's `global` home is the POSITIONAL package (U2).  The same block form OUTSIDE a region is #4421 (not reached by the port).

Guard: Pl/t/requalify-binder-01.t rows 7-8.


=== DONE (s533b) ===
Fixed by the requalifier port (1c port 1, commit 75e513e0, generation v2-10900): `_requalify_region` asks `Pl::Binder::requalify_home` (perl's pad model) instead of the deleted `_binding_at` scope walk.  r8.pl and N5.pl: base so= env= / U2::y=u U::y=u2y; s533b = perl (so=ms env=ok / U2::y=u2y U::y=u).  No site in the four populations.  Guard Pl/t/requalify-binder-01.t rows 7-8 (both fail on the base).


=== COMPLETED at the s533b merge (2026-11-03, reviewing session) ===
Merged as main 7a4cbf67; reproducer probed perl -> main 1aa5d0e5 -> tree: tree = perl.
